mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN `role` r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} HAVING p.code IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT p.menu_id FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN `role` r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.id,p.code,p.name,p.menu_id FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN `role` r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} HAVING p.id IS NOT NULL;
